description: Decompose DEFLATE decompression into a pipeline of stages: (1) Huffman decode to emit literal/length/distance tokens, (2) LZ77 reconstruction to copy bytes, (3) Adler32/CRC32 checksum. Pipeline these stages across chunks so that while chunk N+1 is being Huffman-decoded, chunk N's LZ77 copy is executing, and chunk N-1's checksum is computing. This uses all three phases concurrently.
mathematical_formalization: Three pipeline stages with latencies T_h (Huffman), T_lz (LZ77), T_ck (checksum). Without pipeline: T_total = K * (T_h + T_lz + T_ck). With 3-stage pipeline: T_total = K * max(T_h, T_lz, T_ck) + 2 * max(T_h, T_lz, T_ck). Speedup S = (T_h + T_lz + T_ck) / max(T_h, T_lz, T_ck). If stages are balanced (T_h ~ T_lz ~ T_ck): S -> 3.
analogical_connections: Industrial assembly line: each station performs one operation as products flow through
Unix pipes: multiple processes connected in a pipeline, each processing data as it flows
Instruction pipeline in CPU: fetch-decode-execute-writeback stages overlap
implementation_hypothesis: Create an intermediate token buffer between Huffman and LZ77 stages. The Huffman decoder writes (type, value) pairs: (LITERAL, byte), (MATCH, length, distance). A separate LZ77 stage reads tokens and performs copies. A third stage computes Adler32 on the final output. Use large-enough chunk sizes (e.g., 32KB) to amortize pipeline overhead. Can also use separate threads for each stage with lock-free queues.
experiment_seed: Implement the 3-stage pipeline with single-thread stage-interleaving (process stage A of chunk 2 while stage B of chunk 1 runs). Measure throughput vs monolithic decode on Silesia corpus. Profile to identify which stage is the bottleneck. Verify correctness of output against zlib reference.
